original_defects: A historical count/AUC/average-return checklist can publish ml_live_ready=true from repeated unverified research events without full-strategy financial acceptance

Boolean and nonfinite reported returns are accepted as numeric observations; finite extreme returns can overflow their direct sum. The pre-existing native API envelope already converted nonfinite results to null: a native HTTP500 was not established. The demonstrated failures are contaminated return statistics and lost finite means, not missing envelope JSON sanitization

contract: Existing checklist thresholds remain diagnostic; ready/ml_live_ready and trading permissions remain false because this endpoint has no guarded full-strategy financial forward-acceptance owner
Caller-provided readiness or financial-validation bits do not create acceptance authority
Activation permission blockers remain separate from historical training/review checklist blockers; missing full-strategy LIVE acceptance must not be inserted into next-model training blockers
Research counts describe bounded event-tail observations, not independent financial trades; duplicates/source tags/absent shadow kinds are not authenticated trade receipts
Preserve finite signed returns and extreme tails without a strategy ceiling; reject missing/invalid/nonfinite/Boolean numeric inputs and fractional count inputs
Scaled finite arithmetic avoids direct-sum overflow without clipping or discarding valid finite values; invalid canonical PnL never falls back to a convenient positive alternative
Visible ML Center warning labels event diagnostics as unreconciled returns rather than validated net PnL or live approval
No operator records, model weights, registry, data generation, trading filters, 0.1 SOL sizing, exits or activation behavior is rewritten
